answer: One concrete mechanism: require consistent long-form persona presence across two disconnected communities. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by making the twenty-first clone cost more than the first twenty combined, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The spiral of work and the sonnet of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a raven to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
